# Claude Code Undocumented Hooks

A hook runs your command when Claude Code reaches a set point, such as before a tool call.
Some hook events, inputs, and outputs are not in the official docs.
Of its 26 rows, 14 are found only in the program, 10 differ from the docs, and 2 work only behind a flag or a gate.
Anthropic can change or remove each item in any release.

## Found Only in the Program

14 items are in the program but not in the official docs.
These are the most useful ones.

- `cloud`: `device` or `skip` for cloud sessions that this machine drives. See [Hooks Handlers](Claude-Code-Hooks-Handlers).
- `rewakeSummary`: One-line user summary for `asyncRewake`. See [Hooks Handlers](Claude-Code-Hooks-Handlers).
- `callback`: A function that an SDK host or a mod registers. See [Hooks Handlers](Claude-Code-Hooks-Handlers).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_HOOKS_SAME_THREAD`: Run function hooks on the main thread, not in a worker. See [Hooks Config](Claude-Code-Hooks-Config).
- `rewakeMessage`: Custom prefix of the system reminder for `asyncRewake`. See [Hooks Handlers](Claude-Code-Hooks-Handlers).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICT_PERSONAL_CONFIG`: Own hooks in user files must succeed. See [Hooks Config](Claude-Code-Hooks-Config).
- `asyncTimeout`: A first reply of `{"async":true,"asyncTimeout":ms}` moves a command hook to the background and sets its time limit. See [Hooks Config](Claude-Code-Hooks-Config).
- `auth_storage_failure`, `computer_use_enter`, `computer_use_exit`: Other values passed as `notificationType` in the bundle. See [Hooks Events Prompt](Claude-Code-Hooks-Events-Prompt).
- `{"async":true,"asyncTimeout":n}`: A first reply that moves the hook to the background. See [Hooks Output](Claude-Code-Hooks-Output).
- `onFailure` has no effect: On async hooks and on `Stop`, `SubagentStop`, `TaskCompleted`, `TeammateIdle`. See [Hooks Config](Claude-Code-Hooks-Config).

## Where the Docs Differ

10 items work in a different way from what the docs say.
This is the whole list.

- Error type: `rate_limit`, `overloaded`, `authentication_failed`, `oauth_org_not_allowed`, `account_on_hold`, `billing_error`, `invalid_request`, `model_not_found`, `server_error`... See [Hooks Config](Claude-Code-Hooks-Config).
- `disableAllHooks`: Turns hooks off. See [Hooks Config](Claude-Code-Hooks-Config).
- `error`: The error type. See [Hooks Events Prompt](Claude-Code-Hooks-Events-Prompt).
- `additionalContext`: Docs: all JSON fields of `Setup` are dropped on every exit code. See [Hooks Events Session](Claude-Code-Hooks-Events-Session).
- Top-level `decision` and `reason`: Deprecated for this event. See [Hooks Events Tool](Claude-Code-Hooks-Events-Tool).
- `destination`: Where the change is kept. See [Hooks Events Tool](Claude-Code-Hooks-Events-Tool).
- `script`: A hook type that some text names. See [Hooks Handlers](Claude-Code-Hooks-Handlers).
- `model`: Model for the check. See [Hooks Handlers](Claude-Code-Hooks-Handlers).
- `scratchpad_dir`: The session scratchpad directory. See [Hooks Output](Claude-Code-Hooks-Output).
- `decision`: Top-level block. See [Hooks Output](Claude-Code-Hooks-Output).

## Behind a Flag or a Gate

2 items work only when a flag or a gate is on.
This is the whole list.

- `Setup`: Fires for `--init-only`, or `--init` or `--maintenance` with `-p`. See [Hooks Events Session](Claude-Code-Hooks-Events-Session).
- `script`: An internal handler with a `file` field. See [Hooks Handlers](Claude-Code-Hooks-Handlers).
